GalleryItem.title: GalleryItem
GalleryItem.description: A portfolio/gallery item showcasing brush production cases or site delivery photos.

id.description: Unique identifier of the gallery item.

title.description: Brief title or header for the gallery item.

description.description: Detailed description of the product or work shown.

imageUrl.description: Base64 encoded string or URL of the image.

createdAt.description: ISO date string of creation date.

Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: An inquiry / estimate request submitted by a prospective client.

clientName.description: Name or handle of the client requesting the quote.

brushType.description: The category or model of brush requested.

content.description: Custom inquiry or request note content.

createdAt.description: ISO date string of submission date.

/gallery/{galleryId}.description: Exposes globally uploaded cases and installation photos to all site visitors.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Allows clients to request estimates and allows staff to manage them.

/site_settings/{settingId}.description: Exposes globally configured contact links and corporate settings.
